2026-09-28.question: Which is the least capable model tier that would reliably complete this task well?

criteria.haiku: A mechanical, fully specified task a small fast model completes reliably: run a named command or script, look something up, rename or reformat, summarise one short item. No judgment, design or debugging expected.
criteria.sonnet: A well-scoped task with a clear goal: implement or fix a described change in known code, review one document, issue or PR, answer a factual question, a routine lookup or write-up. Needs competence, not deep reasoning.
criteria.opus: Open-ended or multi-step work that needs sustained judgment: assess claims critically, design an approach, debug an unknown cause, change many files, synthesise research across sources.
criteria.fable: Frontier-hard work where depth matters more than cost: novel research or experiments with uncertain outcomes, subtle correctness or security reasoning, long autonomous projects spanning many hours.

2026-09-28.judgeable: The prompt itself describes the work to be done, so its difficulty can be judged without opening a linked issue, memory id, file, paper or web page.

scope.quick: A single answer, a short conversation or one small change, done within minutes.
scope.task: A focused task of several steps, finished within about an hour.
scope.project: An extended session: research, experiments or many changes over hours.
